6.why: The longest text on any screen is two short sentences; no long reading blocks are required to proceed.

7.why: A 'Copy setup secret' button accompanies the manual secret and a 'Copy all codes' button accompanies the recovery codes.

11.why: Each screen has a single blue primary action, but the enrolment screen (step 4) combines scanning/copying the secret, entering a code, and confirming on one page.
